name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $104 after a near-4% fall on 2 Nov on Iran's Hormuz offer; strait still largely shut
state: Brent was near $104.4 late on 2 Nov after falling almost 4% as Iran said it could reopen Hormuz within two days if the US ends its blockade (Euronews); it is still 4% up on the month. No US reply had been reported, and Trump said on 1 Nov he may have to give Tehran "the hammer" (CBS). The status stays at Alert under the board's hysteresis rule while Hormuz remains largely shut.
for_you: Expect continued high petrol, diesel and heating-oil prices, with knock-on effects on transport costs and inflation.
rubric_hit: Brent $104.4 below $110 Alert line, held by hysteresis; Hormuz largely shut

sources.title: Euronews — Iran says it can reopen Hormuz in two days if US meets conditions

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
